mcqs.question: What significant development was reported regarding the Singapore Convention on Mediation in September 2026?
options: More states ratified the UN Convention on International Settlement Agreements
The convention was replaced by a legally binding global plastics treaty
The convention established a joint maritime security protocol
The convention created the Global Biofuel Alliance
mcqs.explanation: More states ratified the Singapore Convention on Mediation, formally known as the UN Convention on International Settlement Agreements. The other options refer to unrelated developments concerning plastics, maritime security and biofuels.

mcqs.question: Which development was associated with the Global Biofuel Alliance in September 2026?
options: It gained new members from Africa and South America
It admitted new members only from Europe and North America
It became a platform for maritime search and rescue cooperation
It was replaced by the Singapore Convention on Mediation
mcqs.explanation: The Global Biofuel Alliance received new members from Africa and South America. The other options misidentify the regions or confuse the alliance with the Singapore Convention and maritime security cooperation.
